server-resident.callerCanceled: The caller canceled this incoming task
server-resident.error.closedNoChange: This resident agent is closed and cannot be changed: create a new one to serve again
server-resident.error.closedNoResume: This resident agent is closed and cannot be resumed: create a new one to serve again
server-resident.error.modeBypass: "{mode}" skips every confirmation; an AI others can call cannot use it
server-resident.error.modeUnknown: This AI ({harness}) has no permission mode "{mode}"; choose from: {modes}
server-resident.error.nodeGone: The workspace's device does not exist or was revoked
server-resident.error.profileMismatch: The identity profile must be a {harness} one, on the device the workspace is on
server-resident.error.toolsUnsupported: {product} cannot limit the tools and extra directories of this AI ({harness}) (only Claude Code supports it so far): leave tools / dirs unset, or use another harness
server-resident.error.workspaceOrProfile: No such workspace or identity profile: look up the ids with `{command} workspace catalog`
server-resident.outcome.error: This turn failed and has no result (no automatic retry): you can send it again with a new messageId
server-resident.outcome.interrupted: This turn was stopped (the owner stopped it, the agent closed, or the device went offline) and has no result; it is not replayed automatically
server-resident.refusal.configGone: This agent's workspace or identity profile no longer exists: ask its owner to check the configuration
server-resident.refusal.contextClosed: This conversation's dedicated session is closed: send a new message without contextId to start a new conversation
server-resident.refusal.dailyTurns: This resident agent reached today's turn limit ({n, plural, one {# turn} other {# turns}} / 24 hours); try again later
server-resident.refusal.noPin: This agent cannot run tasks now: its owner has not set a PIN yet
server-resident.refusal.notTaking: This resident agent takes no calls now
server-resident.refusal.paused: This resident agent is paused and takes no calls now: try again after its owner resumes it
server-resident.refusal.queueFull: Too many tasks are queued in this conversation ({n}); send again after the earlier ones finish
server-resident.session.title: Resident · {agent} · {caller}
